name: prefixPotential_eq_potential
lines: ⊢ (prefixPotential G η fun s => actions ⟨↑s, ⋯⟩) = potential η (G.toLossSeq actions) ↑t
⊢ ∑ i, prefixHedgeWeight G η (fun s => actions ⟨↑s, ⋯⟩) i = ∑ i, hedgeWeight η (G.toLossSeq actions) (↑t) i
⊢ ∀ x ∈ univ, prefixHedgeWeight G η (fun s => actions ⟨↑s, ⋯⟩) x = hedgeWeight η (G.toLossSeq actions) (↑t) x
⊢ prefixHedgeWeight G η (fun s => actions ⟨↑s, ⋯⟩) i = hedgeWeight η (G.toLossSeq actions) (↑t) i
⊢ i ∈ univ → prefixHedgeWeight G η (fun s => actions ⟨↑s, ⋯⟩) i = hedgeWeight η (G.toLossSeq actions) (↑t) i

steps.tactic: exact prefixHedgeWeight_eq_hedgeWeight G η actions t i
